theorems.statement: ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Eucl P), ‖simpleNVector v‖ ^ 2 = (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (v i) (v j)).det) ∧ ∀ (P n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (τ : Fin n → Eucl P), simpleNVector (fun i => ∑ j, B i j • τ j) = B.det • simpleNVector τ) → ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → (∀ᵐ w ∂((volume : Measure (Eucl n)).restrict (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' M)), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ (Φ w) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w).toLinearMap) ∧ HasFDerivAt (f ∘ Φ) ((L (Φ w)).comp (fderiv ℝ Φ w)) w) → ∀ᵐ w ∂((volume : Measure (Eucl n)).restrict (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' M)), ‖nVectorPushforward n (L (Φ w)) (ξ (Φ w))‖ₑ * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det) = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det)
